build_shared_mlp: build a SharedMLP module with a list of channel sizes for point cloud feature extraction
create_conv2d_layer: create a Conv2d layer with optional batch normalization and ReLU activation for point cloud processing
create_conv1d_layer: create a Conv1d layer with optional batch normalization and preact mode for 1D feature maps
create_conv3d_layer: create a Conv3d layer with configurable kernel size, stride, and padding for 3D convolutions
create_fc_layer: create a fully connected FC layer with optional batch normalization and activation for classification heads
create_bn_momentum_scheduler: create a BNMomentumScheduler to dynamically adjust batch norm momentum across training epochs
set_bn_momentum_default: set the default batch normalization momentum value across all BN layers in a model
review_shared_mlp: review the SharedMLP class to understand how it chains Conv2d layers with configurable batch norm
review_conv_base: review the _ConvBase class to understand the preact vs postact layer ordering logic
review_bn_momentum_scheduler: review the BNMomentumScheduler class to understand how it applies a lambda function per epoch
